prediction.semantics: Full predicted trajectory unless expected_duration_seconds is explicitly supplied; geometric agreement does not establish physical collision or traversal under arbitrary long-flight parameters.

approximation.note: Straight chords approximate the parabola; this bound is the maximum vertical interpolation deviation, not a zero-error continuous curve claim.
